project_name: University of Puget Sound Courseware System
initial_requirements: The University of Puget Sound needs a courseware system that better supports its instructional and educational practices. Students, professors, and system administrators should be able to manage courses, assignments, learning materials, discussions, and grades through a coherent online environment. The project should also improve collaboration and access to course content while allowing the university to refine the system as stakeholder needs become clearer.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary goals you want this courseware system to achieve for students, professors, and administrators, and what specific responsibilities or interactions should each of those stakeholder groups have in the system?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
For students, the main goal is to give them a single place to see their courses, assignments, readings, announcements, and grades without having to hunt around. They should be able to submit work, participate in discussions, and check feedback or updates easily.
For professors, the system should help them manage course content, create and post assignments, communicate with students, run discussions, and record or publish grades. For administrators, the focus is on maintaining the system and supporting course setup, user access, and general oversight so the platform stays reliable and organized. I’d expect each group to have permissions appropriate to their role, but the exact boundaries may need to be worked out as we learn more about campus needs.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Provide a single online courseware environment where students can easily access courses, assignments, readings, announcements, grades, feedback, and updates; help professors manage course content, assignments, communication, discussions, and grade publication; and support administrators in maintaining the system, course setup, user access, and overall oversight.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Students view course information and submit work; professors manage course content, assignments, communication, discussions, and grades; administrators maintain the system, support course setup and user access, and provide general oversight.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Students need to view courses, assignments, readings, announcements, grades, feedback, and updates, submit work, and participate in discussions. Professors need to create and post assignments, manage course content, communicate with students, run discussions, and record or publish grades. Administrators need tools for system maintenance, course setup, user access management, and oversight.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: Users should have permissions appropriate to their role, with exact access boundaries to be determined as campus needs are clarified.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Courses, assignments, readings, announcements, grades, feedback, updates, discussions, course content, users, and access/permission information.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Role-based permissions are required, but the precise permission boundaries are not yet fully defined and must be refined as stakeholder needs become clearer.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: The system should be reliable and organized, with easy access to course information and sufficient support for collaboration and communication.
